en.sayyid-mohsen-al-husayni-al-milani: 2. My father narrated to me through his Isnād from Abī Basīr, who said:

I heard Abā ‘Abdillāh (Imam Sādiq (a.s.)) – or Abā Ja’far (Imam Bāqir (a.s.)) – say: Those who want their destination and abode to be Paradise should not neglect going to the Ziyārah of the oppressed one.
I asked, “Who is the oppressed one?” Imam (a.s.) replied: Ḥusain ibn ‘Ali (a.s.), the man of Karbalā.

Allah will make those who go to his Ziyārah yearning for him and with love for the Messenger of Allāh (s.a.a.w.), love for the Commander of the Believers (a.s.), and love for Fāťimah (s.a.), sit at the Mawā`id of Paradise. They will be eating with them while others are undergoing the process of Judgment.
